stemMd: What is the coefficient of x² in (x + 2)(x² − 3x + 5)?
explanationMd: Only two products contribute to x²: x(−3x) = −3x² and 2(x²) = 2x². Their sum is −x², so the coefficient is −1. There is no need to expand every term.

distractorRationale.c: This counts the x times −3x contribution but omits 2 times x².
distractorRationale.d: This counts only the second contribution.
distractorRationale.b: This is unrelated to the combined x² terms.
distractorRationale.a: This comes from the x term produced by 2 times −3x.
